html:
An Armenian eunuch who rose from the palace staff of Justinian to become one of his best generals. He was in charge of the imperial treasury and the emperor's bedchamber when, in the Nika riots of 532, he helped end the revolt by bribing leaders of the Blue faction.

He was sent to Italy in 538 but quarrelled with Belisarius and was recalled. In 551, though over seventy, he was given a large, well paid army to finish the Gothic War.

  • At the Battle of Taginae in 552 he crushed the Gothic king Totila, who died of his wounds.
  • He beat the last Gothic king, Teia, near Vesuvius soon after.
  • At the Volturnus in 554 he destroyed an army of Franks and Alamanni.

He then governed Italy until Justin II dismissed him around 567. A later story claims he invited the Lombards into Italy in revenge; there is no good evidence for it.
